program.title: Eddie Hearn blames Dana White’s ‘arrogance’ for nasty rhetoric in lead-up to Fury vs. Joshua: ‘They’re control freaks’
program.body:
ADD THE STORY HERE.“What do you expect me to do when it’s a breach of the agreement?” Hearn told The Stomping Ground on Thursday. “Just go, ‘Oh these guys are coming into boxing, I suppose I better just lay down and let them walk all over me and tickle my balls.’ No, obviously not. I’m going to turn around and say f*cking no way, son, not on my watch. Are you f*cking serious? Everything that they did made me fight harder.

“Really what they should have done and I told SELA this originally. What you need to do is tell Dana White when he speaks just to say, ‘I understand contractually we can’t be involved in the event, however, Turki Alalshikh, Netflix, I think would like us to be involved in the event so what I’m going to do is sit down with Eddie and Turki and we’ll talk about it and try to find a solution.’ That’s it. I probably would have had that meeting and just gone ‘Sweet, we’ll find a way.’ You expect me, the way we were disrespected, to allow that? No way.”’

program.title: Dana White’s name booed mercilessly by crowd
program.body: UFC CEO Dana White was back at home in Las Vegas, but his presence still loomed large at the first Tyson Fury vs. Anthony Joshua press conference on Wednesday.

program.title: Deiveson Figueiredo interested in flyweight return
program.body: At the moment, Figueiredo has more immediate concerns as he looks to snap a two-fight skid against the heavily favored Talbott. Still, if he pulls off the upset and the UFC is willing to give him a chance, he looks forward to going toe-to-toe with Van. “Everybody wants to exchange with him and he’s a striker,” Figueiredo said. “I’m a striker and a grappler, so believe me, if he wants to strike with me, the effect won’t be the same and he will not want to exchange with me. Pantoja’s an amazing fighter, but I think the game plan was wrong because he was just trying to push the striking in this fight. Why not use more grappling in this fight with the excellent jiu-jitsu he’s got?”

program.title: Payton Talbott says he ‘reinvented’ himself ahead of UFC 332
program.body: “Yeah, it was kind of weird,” Talbott told the UFC when asked about his nine-month hiatus. “This is all still new to me, so I tried to just stay training and just stay ready. I mean, I trained pretty much the whole year, and I feel like I kind of reinvented myself a little bit and went back to my roots, went inward.”

program.title: FIGHT CITY FORECAST
Alexander Hernandez says feds asked if he planned to throw UFC fight
program.body: Hernandez, who returns to action in the Ultimate Fighting Championship at UFC 332 on Oct. 3, was scheduled to face Johnson at UFC 324 in January. However, the fight was canceled at the last minute amid suspicious betting-line movement. Hernandez opened as a sizable favorite, but money reportedly began pouring in on Johnson a day before the fight, shifting the odds in his favor. Hernandez said he was subsequently questioned by federal agents about whether he was planning to throw the fight. “They’re like, ‘Do you have any incriminating apps?’ I’m like, ‘I don’t even know what an incriminating app would look like.’ They say, ‘Signal,’ and I’m like, ‘What’s Signal?’... I open it up, and one was a bot message saying hey or something, and the other was me buying like a gram of weed in Brazil,” Hernandez told Ariel Helwani. “I was like, ‘OK, that’s kind of embarrassing. That's a p*ssy amount, I’ll admit that, but it was certainly not insider trading, not throwing a f***ing fight.’ Embarrassing exchange, sure. Federal charge, I’d say not… I probably sat in there spinning our wheels together for nearly an hour, I’d imagine.”

program.title: Masayuki Kikuir will participate in PANCRASE for the first time in 5 years
program.body: Former PANCRASE welterweight champion Masayuki Kikuiri will return to the promotion for the first time in five years at PANCRASE 368 on November 8. Kikuiri (11-4-1), who has since fought in Bellator and PFL, will face 71-fight veteran Alonzo Martinez (46-24-1), who enters the matchup following back-to-back KO wins in BKFC.

program.title: Super Rec relinquishes flyweight kickboxing title "I'll definitely be back"
program.body: ONE Flyweight Kickboxing World Champion Superlek Gatmoo 9 has announced that he will vacate the title to focus on recovering from a torn ACL in his right knee.

program.title: Brandon Moreno returns to action
program.body: Multiple sources have confirmed the matchup to Heavy.com after an initial report by MMA Fighting. Both men discussed a potential matchup on social media a couple of weeks ago. Moreno is ranked number eight in the UFC Media rankings and number nine in the UFC Meta rankings. Meanwhile, Johnson is ranked only in the UFC Meta rankings, at number 14.

program.title: Ryan Cafaro Expects Experience Edge Over Hidemasa Yasui at RIZIN LANDMARK 16
program.body: Ryan Cafaro believes his experience and pace will be the difference when he faces Hidemasa Yasui at RIZIN LANDMARK 16 on October 3. Cafaro expects Yasui to fade as the fight goes on and also reiterated that he still hopes to eventually face Ren Hiramoto.

program.title: Eddie Hearn disappointed with Tyson Fury vs. Anthony Joshua press conference
program.body: "I have to be honest. And I don't mean to be disrespectful to Max Kellerman, who I think is a fantastic broadcaster; they should just let me do it. Like, it's too- it's a little bit too long-winded, you know? And it's a little bit too staged, if I'm honest," Hearn stated

program.title: Aljamain Sterling given ‘one hour’ to accept UFC Qatar fight, rejected Aaron Pico
program.body:
"I was told I had an hour to give an answer, and I had just gotten off the mats," Sterling told Yahoo Sports. "I didn't even get a chance to talk to my team. I guess the negotiations were already in the works, and the opportunity would have gone to someone else."

"These things move quickly," Sterling continued. "It was a situation where they had to make an announcement for the card, and it just happened that I was training at that time. Luckily, it worked out because I did want to fight one more time before this year was up. A lot of people think I just want to sit on the sidelines. It's not even that. There are just no matchups."

program.title: Boating accident, 4.5-month concussion force Tito Ortiz to close ‘perfect’ Florida Mexican restaurant
program.body: “On February 28th of this year, I got in a boating accident, and I’ve been hurt now for the last eight months,” Ortiz said. “It’s been hard. I’ve had neck surgery. I had a concussion for over four and a half months. Over the last eight months, I’ve shown up maybe 15 times. It really has hurt my business a lot, being injured.”

program.title: Video by titos.cantina
Rogan advocates for oblique kick to be banned from the UFC
program.body: “I understand that it’s combat, but so is poking in the eyes, and we don’t allow poking in the eyes. There’s a real conversation about whether or not it should be legal. Andy Foster I think is one of the best without a doubt, and he thinks it should be banned. And the UFC think it should be banned. There’s just too many guys (getting injured by it). It just takes one and you hyper-extend your knee and your f***ed forever, your career is over,” Rogan continued.
